output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to a large amount.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow in these two lines: 'require (balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to]);' and 'assert(balanceOf[_from] + balanceOf[_to] == previousBalances);'. An attacker can make the _to user's balance extremely large and cause a denial of service to the users who receive tokens.
